name: Alertas agrícolas regionales · piloto Cusco

hazards.name: Riesgo de sequía
hazards.action: Monitorea la lluvia y las fuentes de agua; contrasta el déficit con información local antes de planificar labores.
hazards.action_en: Monitor rainfall and water sources; check the deficit locally before planning fieldwork.

hazards.name: Temperaturas extremas
hazards.action: Revisa el pronóstico local y la sensibilidad del cultivo y su etapa antes de programar labores.
hazards.action_en: Check the local forecast and crop and growth-stage sensitivity before scheduling fieldwork.

hazards.name: Exceso de precipitaciones
hazards.action: Revisa drenaje y acumulación de agua y consulta los avisos de SENAMHI antes de programar labores.
hazards.action_en: Check drainage and water accumulation and consult SENAMHI advisories before scheduling fieldwork.

hazards.name: Posible erosión
hazards.action: Inspecciona escorrentía y suelo expuesto en laderas. La señal de lluvia y pendiente requiere comprobar cobertura y propiedades del suelo.
hazards.action_en: Inspect runoff and exposed soil on slopes. The rainfall and slope signal needs local cover and soil checks.

hazards.name: Posible estrés hídrico
hazards.action: Comprueba la humedad de la zona radicular y el acceso al agua antes de tomar decisiones de riego; no se calcula una dosis de riego.
hazards.action_en: Check root-zone moisture and water access before irrigation decisions; no irrigation amount is calculated.

limitations: Experimental regional screening thresholds defined by TERRA360, not calibrated crop-specific damage limits or official SENAMHI warnings.
Nine regional monitoring points, not a continuous hazard map, property boundaries or safe zones between points.
ERA5 and ECMWF IFS 0.25-degree estimates (~27 km); terrain and valleys can differ from the model grid.
Drought is a 30-day rainfall percentile signal, not SPI, an official drought declaration or a loss probability.
Soil water is modeled over 0–100 cm and delayed seven days; water stress is a proxy without crop coefficients, measured roots or irrigation records.
Erosion combines predicted rain and neighborhood DSM slope only; missing soil erodibility, cover, slope length and conservation practices prevent estimating soil loss.
No signal does not mean safe. Missing or expired data never become a no-risk classification.
